decisions.decision: Abandoned stick pose estimator (v6) after audit proved it causes label leakage and physically wrong stick geometry
decisions.rationale: Estimator uses ground-truth class_idx to pick hardcoded direction → model memorizes label-specific fake geometry. Zero-stick fallback (v5) achieved 77.7% by forcing model to learn from body pose alone.

decisions.decision: Chosen Option A: Revert to zero-stick fallback + true zero nodes + masked global_mean_pool
decisions.rationale: v5 showed 77.7% with zero-stick, but `global_mean_pool` still averaged 35 nodes including 2 garbage nodes with non-zero `dist_to_hip`. True zero nodes + masked pooling should raise this to 80-85%.
